Enhance Your Practice With Our Credentialing Solutions

Credentialing bottlenecks can keep your medical practice from making progress. At AltuMED, we help you eliminate laborious work and focus on growth. Our credentialing services are designed to reduce repetitive tasks and help you save time and resources.

What Sets Our Physician and Healthcare Provider Credentialing Services Apart

  • Extensive Credentialing Expertise
  • Customized Services for Organization
  • The AltuMED Difference
Extensive Credentialing Expertise

To ensure the provision of quality service, we:

Verify medical credentials and qualifications with sources

Confirm the authenticity of licenses, certifications, and other documentation

Evaluate quality of care through medical record reviews

Ensure appropriate privileges to perform services

Identify areas for improvement via cross-disciplinary teams

Track completion of CEUs and professional development

Confirm professionals stay updated on the latest advancements

Assist in developing credentialing policies and processes

Ensure compliance with relevant regulations and standards

The AltuMED Difference

The AltuMED Difference

Increased efficiency through streamlined processes

Scalable solutions serve organizations of all sizes

Ongoing support adapting to your changing requirements

We provide high-end credentialing services to support effective healthcare system management. We help you shift your focus to efficient patient care. You can delegate verification, compliance, and quality assurance to us and do what you do best.

Onboarding

Using our extensive industry knowledge, we help you network with the most suitable insurers.

Application

We prepare insurance applications after receiving documentation from your side. The application process is completed within a week.

Follow-up

Once the application has been submitted, we check with the insurers for confirmation. We continue our follow-up to ensure that the enrollment process has begun.

Completion

We let you know as soon as we receive confirmation for insurance approval. We send you all the insurer or payer details you must know. Now, you are ready to see patients with coverage from that insurance company.

Credentialing Services

We pay attention to every small detail when performing credentialing and contracting. We ensure your practice adheres to policies and rules set by insurers and regulatory bodies. For this, we perform diligent provider verification, compliance checks, and quality assurance.

Credentialing Services

Our team assists with the smooth registration of healthcare providers with insurers. We take care of all the steps, including provider information submission, network participation, and re-enrollments.
